svg.title: Three production failures and the design that survives them
svg.text: Three production failures, and the design that survives each one
Top: what happened. Bottom: what the platform does instead. All three are covered in the article with numbers.
PSP p99 goes from 400 ms to 12 s.
Client timeout is the library default, 60 s.
55 orders/s x 12 s = 660 calls in flight.
Requests queue for the pool, health checks
time out, pods restart. Cart shares the
pool, so the whole buy path goes down.
Timeout 3 s, one retry with the same key.
over 30 s, routes new auths to PSP B.
Code reads stock, checks > 0, then writes.
One atomic statement, no read first:
Hot SKU split into 10 rows of 50 units
Each request picks a random bucket with stock. Empty buckets are skipped.
Shopper taps "Place order" on a train.
Request reaches checkout, order is made,
card is charged, response is lost.
duplicates, each one a support ticket.
checkout attempt, sends it on retries.
Checkout stores key + response for 24 h
Same key, same body → saved response.
